page.notes: The Greek phrase after "Christus" (about 30 letters, from Luke 1 and 1 Cor.) could not be read letter by letter and is marked illegible. "δημαγωγός" is a best reading of the Greek, marked [?]. Marginal references read "Luc. 1*.1" and "1 Cor. f.10"; the chapter marks are uncertain. The final line "externorum" is a catchword, italic and printed below the text. Left-edge fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are excluded.
